stories.title: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it

stories.title: Nvidia's leadership crisis rattles the AI trade. Here's how we're adjusting our portfolio
stories.summary: Despite the turbulence, the S&P 500 secured a weekly gain of 2.5%, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq added 2.3%.

stories.title: How Nvidia turmoil and a Democratic Congress could reshape the AI trade, according to ETF experts
stories.summary: ETF experts say Nvidia’s leadership turmoil and Democratic control of Congress could shift AI demand to the benefit of other Big Tech stocks, rival chipmakers.

stories.title: Nvidia board urged to consider 'potential return of Jensen Huang' by two major investors
stories.summary: Two Nvidia investors with about $2.13 billion of stock disclosed as of June 30 are calling for a deliberate leadership search after Huang’s resignation.

stories.title: Beware the New AI-Fueled Ransomware Boom
stories.summary: Fully automated ransomware hasn’t arrived—yet. But seemingly unsophisticated attackers are using AI tools to wreak havoc.
